description: Frozen input/output pairs for the PR 4 extraction surface: the ranking barrel contract, round2 and the build signature, the derived compatibility status, rankBuilds ordering and its top-N cap, selectDiverseTop pair-cap selection and selectArchetypes strategy selection (including Decision 58 objectives), plus one composed pipeline over a fixed 11-build set. DB-free: every build is assembled from literals.
timestamp_policy: No ambient clock is read while capturing: every id, score and price is an input literal, so the document is byte-stable on its baseline commit. String order is recorded by code unit; nothing here reads a locale.

provenance.origin: Captured from the PRE-MOVE implementation under src/recommendation/ranking/ before any module moved into packages/recommendation-core. The committed document is the baseline: do not regenerate it from the extracted code, because a fixture produced by the implementation under test proves nothing.
